prompt: Generate ONE new FINAL CLEARING ground map for an autumn woodland in Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky DS pixel-art style. Landscape 4:3, 1200 x 896 pixels, elevated top-down game camera. Image ONE is the original green ROM D24P11A, for small native-scale leaf clusters, roots and natural forest texture. Image TWO is our invented autumn ENTRANCE, for its muted copper-brown foliage, olive moss, warm leaf litter and ochre-brown ground. Autumn is an invented seasonal interpretation, NOT an official ROM palette. Create a DIFFERENT tree arrangement and floor layout, not the entrance with its winding path erased. A very large OPEN connected clearing occupies the centre and lower-right middle. At NORTH a closed uneven line of leafy trees, roots and undergrowth slopes diagonally from upper-left towards upper-right; no trail or opening through the north trees. One wider forked trunk belongs at the NORTHWEST RIM only, never in the central floor. The LEFT edge has deeper overlapping medium-sized trees, the RIGHT edge thinner irregular fern borders with several trees. A broad grassy and earthy approach enters ONLY from SOUTH centre, at least a third of the bottom width. Ground is textured olive short grass, subtle fine fallen brown leaves and a few small irregular subdued ochre-brown bare-earth patches merging naturally, NOT one large flat brown blob or a circular arena marking. Keep the central movement area clear of trees, stumps, rocks, flowers, logs or other landmarks. Tiny ferns and mushrooms may appear near side roots only. Forest and treetops continue OFF all four corners, no blank margins, no floating island silhouette, no symmetrical tree ring. Subdued warm bronze and copper midtones like image two, leaf midtones near RGB 160 125 45, dark brown shadows and olive moss, not brilliant orange, vivid red or glowing gold. Crisp native DS pixel clusters, not huge smooth tree blobs, thick black ink contours or high-resolution fantasy painting. No sky, horizon, cliffs, cave, water, architecture, stairs, altar, shrine, symbol, magical effects, sun beams, Pokemon, characters, text or UI. Single full-frame map.
